description: Scan Google News and PR wires for funding rounds, executive moves, product launches, and acquisitions at any company domain. Returns deduplicated, dated events in flat Clay-ready JSON. Pass signal_types to report one kind of event and lookback_days to set the window. Read-only; requires APIFY_TOKEN; consumes Apify credits.

company_name.description: Optional company name hint, used when the domain does not match the brand name, e.g. Deel for deel.com.

domain.description: Company domain to scan, without https or www, e.g. stripe.com.

lookback_days.description: How far back to search, in days. Default 365. Shorten it for trigger based outbound, where a raise from eleven months ago is not a trigger.

signal_types.description: Report only these event types. Narrowing narrows the search as well as the answer, so a funding only scan issues one news query instead of four. Omit for every type.

name: get_funding_press_signals
title: Get Funding and Press Signals
